title: LMDB (Lightning Memory-Mapped Database) signature
summary: An LMDB database file begins with a 4KB page. The meta page (page 0) contains the magic 0xBEEFC0DE at offset 0 (or 0x00010000 for the environment).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LMDB is a B+ tree-based key-value store with memory-mapped I/O.
LMDB is used by OpenLDAP, and many embedded systems.
LMDB supports multiple readers with a single writer (MVCC).
